items.title: 66100_Bud Freeman oral history interview
items.q: I was sitting with a very old friend of ours, Stan Warren

ctx.x: Yes, we'll go back. What I wanted to ask you was, when were you demobbed, in '45?
I came out of the Army in -- I was home on furlough and I was sitting with a very old friend of ours, Stan Warren -- do you remember Stan?
